description: A chain of actions is bounded (ADR-0044, item 6). An action queued by a caller's command has depth 0; one queued by the commit an action of depth d made has depth d + 1; one deeper than 16 is written dead with too_deep and its action_failed event. A class whose rule creates documents of itself therefore stops, with a record of where, and every document of the chain is caused by the one before it.

script.name: the first document queues the second
a drain follows the chain to its bound: seventeen actions run
eighteen documents: the first and the seventeen the actions made
the last one's action was written dead
